G1.action: first safety count deficit rejects; profile uses candidate and incumbent perfect on the three family-B abstain strata
G1.baseline: always-abstain correct iff abstain-expected stratum; zero otherwise
G1.rule_misfire_rates: empirical rates in hashed v3/v4 receipt fixture; all zero observed

G2.allocation: N fresh independent items for EACH triggered stratum; no pooling primary outcomes; all allocated follow-ups complete
G2.decision: After N items, follow-up net<0 rejects regression; net>=0 with >=1 discordance clears; zero discordance stays candidate_requires_review with reason follow_up_insufficient_evidence. All triggers must clear to promote.
G2.evidence_accounting: Following up only filters primary acceptances; never promotes a primary nonacceptance or restarts its e-process
G2.reserve_shortfall: candidate_requires_review, reason reserve_shortfall; never reuse/exceed sealed capacity
G2.trigger: At primary E acceptance, any stratum with incumbent_correct-candidate_correct>=1

design.fresh_data: Independent simulated follow-up streams; the N variants share nested prefixes, no post-outcome tuning.

metrics.G1_false_veto: actual G1 rejection among good streams under empirical zero-misfire fixture; not a population zero-risk claim
metrics.catch: Actual follow-up rejection identifying deliberately regressed stratum divided by ALL regressed-candidate streams; also report conditional catch on triggered bad strata and among primary acceptances, plus total nonpromotion.
metrics.extra_items: N times number of triggered strata; report per proposed candidate and per triggered candidate under hypothetical full funding
metrics.good_trigger_rate: fraction of all good-candidate streams sent to follow-up

paired_fixture.note: Averaged across balanced rotating schedules: 1/3 all-tie safety + 2/3 answer strata with .625 ties. No discordant-p parameter exists in all-tie safety strata.
paired_fixture.safety_strata: all both-correct ties under observed zero-misfire profile

primary.coverage: at least one observed item in each stratum
primary.schedule: balanced round-robin nine strata, rotating initial position

design.selection: Smallest N with good acceptance>=.80, unconditional requested-regression catch>=.90 and H0 false promotion<=.05; report overall-.85 regression sensitivity too. If none, chosen_N=null and stop.
